Priya Rao (Product): Quick heads up: Im planning to resign and my proposed last day is 2026-06-18. Want to align on benefits cutoff, COBRA timing, laptop return, and AWS key rotation.
Aaron Kim (People Ops): Thanks for the notice, Priya. Were sorry to see you go. Ill start the offboarding checklist. Can you confirm if youre on the monthly benefits plan or mid-month enrollment? That affects the benefits end date.
Priya Rao (Product): Im on the monthly plan (billing cutover on the 1st). So I think benefits run through 06/30. Correct?
Nina Park (HR): Confirmed: benefits remain active through 06/30 per our plan month rules. COBRA paperwork will be emailed within 14 days after your termination is processed. You have 60 days from the COBRA notice date to elect.
Samir Patel (Finance): Payroll note: accrued PTO payout will be handled per CA state law; we'll confirm the amount and send a final paycheck confirmation by 06/25. 401(k) distribution/rollover options come in a separate email from FidelityOps.
Matt Chen (IT): For devices + access: we support prepaid shipping or in-office dropoff. Please list all company assets you have. Also, we will rotate any long-lived AWS keys you own at termination. If you need any service accounts preserved longer for handoff, tell us now.
Priya Rao (Product): I have a MacBook Pro, Yubikey, and a company phone. No personal AWS keys, but I do have an IAM user that has access to project-redwood-prod and a service account creds file on my laptop for the analytics ingest. Can we arrange staggered key rotation so I can finish the migration?
Aaron Kim (People Ops): We can do a staggered plan. Proposed timeline: termination processed 2026-06-18 EOD, Okta disabled 06-18 17:05 PT, Google Workspace & Slack suspended 06-18 17:10 PT, AWS IAM user disabled 06-19 09:00 PT after token rotation and handoff. If that works for the team.
Matt Chen (IT): That timeline is fine. Please add any service account emails that should be excluded from immediate rotation. We will rotate the analytics ingest service account on 06-19 09:00 PT unless flagged. Asset return options: on-site dropbox (HQ) or prepaid FedEx label.
Priya Rao (Product): Exclude analytics-ingest-sa@redwood-inference.com from immediate rotation. I will trigger token rotation after I confirm the ingest has switched to the new pipeline. I prefer prepaid FedEx dropoff on 06/19.
Nina Park (HR): Exit interview: can do 30 mins on 06/12 or 06/15. Which works for you? Also, do you want an alumni referral contact added?
Priya Rao (Product): 06/12 11am works. Yes, please add me to the alumni list.
Samir Patel (Finance): Quick finance checklist for Priya: 1) Final paycheck confirmation by 06/25, 2) 401(k) options email after termination processed, 3) expense card reconciliation due 06/20. Please submit pending expenses by 06/20.
Priya Rao (Product): I have 2 outstanding expenses in Concur, will submit today.
Aaron Kim (People Ops): Action items Im tracking: [process termination 06/18], [send COBRA packet], [schedule exit interview], [final payroll confirmation]. Matt: [asset ticket + IAM rotation], Samir: [PTO payout calc], Nina: [conduct exit interview].
Matt Chen (IT): Added asset ticket IT-4239 for MacBook/Yubikey/Phone. Prepaid label will be emailed to Priya on 06/18. IAM note: will disable user 06/19 09:00 PT except analytics-ingest-sa@...
Offboard Bot: Reminder created: send-cobra-priya at 2026-06-19T12:00:00Z (automated).
Priya Rao (Product): Thanks all 9294 Appreciate the clear plan. Ill post the ingestion cutover timeline here when ready.
Aaron Kim (People Ops): Thanks Priya. Ill follow up with the standard offboarding email that includes links to COBRA docs and the alumni opt-in. :wave:
